blocks.title: Molar concentration
blocks.text: Solution ki molar concentration, mol/dm3 mein, kisi madde (reactant ya product) ke moles ki tadaad hai jo dm3 mein solution ke fi hajm hal hai: C = n / V, to n = C x V.

Yahan C molar concentration aur V solution ka hajm hai. Molar concentration mole tak raston ka set mukammal karti hai: mass taqseem molar mass, hajm taqseem molar volume, zarraat taqseem Avogadro's number, aur concentration zarb hajm. Sample Problem 4.10: 27.64 g K2CO3 1 dm3 solution mein hal; K2CO3 ka molar mass 138.2 g/mol hai, to n = 27.64 / 138.2 = 0.2 mol aur C = 0.2 mol / 1 dm3 = 0.2 mol/dm3.

blocks.prompt: 1 dm3 solution mein hal 7.9 g KMnO4 (molar mass 158 g/mol) ki molar concentration nikalein, aur 250 cm3 mein 4.0 g NaOH (40 g/mol) ki.

items: Molar concentration C = n / V mol/dm3 mein, aur n = C x V; 1 dm3 mein 27.64 g K2CO3 (138.2 g/mol) 0.2 mol/dm3 hai.
